description: Save one checklist's playlist after the server checks it. lines is the ordered list of the playlist's lines. The server checks that line_ids are unique and order runs 1, 2, 3 without gaps; that the credits of every line except option_list and note add up to the published credits (within the range, where a range is published); that every slot's fills_from names an option_list and every option_list is named by a slot; that every course code is one of the school's learning units; that every area designation is in the school policy; that choose has n no greater than its courses; that every quote appears verbatim in the capture its source names, which may be the requirements section, a linked section, or any other capture held for the checklist's school; and that every course code in the requirements text appears in a line or in a note line that names it. It never alters what the lines say; it adds accepts to each area line and min_courses where the text names a number of courses. It returns playlist_id, status, and every error in plain words, each naming its line: lines with errors are saved as rejected, so correct them and save again. A build that passes replaces the playlist in use only when there is none, when the catalog page has changed, or when the one in use is unverified or rejected. Otherwise it is kept as a candidate: the answer gives candidate_id and the playlist in use, the candidate is never used for anyone's progress, and playlist_compare compares the two.

built_by.description: Who built this playlist: a short string naming the agent and model. Stored with the saved playlist. A save without it is rejected.

courses.description: Course codes, for course, one_of, choose and option_list; otherwise empty

credits.description: A number; null only for option_list and note

designation.description: area only: the designation exactly as in the school policy. The save stores on the line, as accepts, the course list the policy holds for the designation; only those courses, or a course of a subject the policy defines the designation by, fill it

fills_from.description: slot only: the line_id of an option_list

heading.description: The group heading the line sits under on the page, as printed

kind.description: course: one required course. one_of: one course from a short list printed on the line. choose: n courses or credits from courses printed together. slot: filled from an option list elsewhere on the page. option_list: a list that feeds slots and never adds to the total by itself. area: any course carrying a designation from the school policy. open: any course that earns credit. note: a printed condition that is not itself credit.

major_elective.description: true on the program's major elective line: it is filled after the area lines and before the open electives

min_courses.description: area, slot and open only: the number of courses the line asks for, where it asks for courses rather than credits. Where it is not given, the save stores it from the line's text when the text names courses, no credits, and one number

source.description: Where the school published it: the capture, named as the manifest or playlist_find_pages names it, and a verbatim passage of 300 characters or fewer from that capture's cleaned text

text.description: One plain sentence a person could follow
examples: Take one BUS/DPR elective from the list below.

name: playlist_save
title: Playlist Save
